question: Under this policy, will I pay a withdrawal charge?

calls.content:
Yes, a withdrawal charge applies to each cash value withdrawal, currently set at US$25, HK$200, or MOP$200 [S2][S4].
This charge is waived if you use the automatic periodic withdrawal option [S2][S4].
The automatic periodic withdrawal option is only available if the policy has been in force for at least 10 years [S4].
Separate from withdrawal charges, a surrender charge may apply if you lapse or surrender the policy, or decrease the Basic Sum Insured, within the first 14 years from the Policy Date or the effective date of each increase in Basic Sum Insured [S2].
The specific Surrender Charge Rate depends on the insured's gender, issue age, smoking habit, risk class, and years in effect [S2].

question: What is the special grace period for unemployment?

calls.content:
The special grace period for unemployment allows the Policy Owner to suspend premium payments for up to 365 days if they are made redundant during the policy's validity [S1].
During this entire "Special Grace Period," the policy remains fully covered by the insurance [S1].
This Unemployment Protection is only applicable to the Basic Plan [S4].
